subject: Forensics Results — Fingerprint Analysis
body:
Detective,

The fingerprint analysis from the Valcourt BioLabs scene is complete.

We recovered three distinct fingerprint samples from the laboratory door handle. Two samples match Dr. Rask himself. The third remains unidentified and is not currently in our database.

The third print shows partial smearing consistent with the use of latex gloves — suggesting deliberate precaution.

Full report is attached. Please cross-reference with the suspect database.

Let me know if you require further analysis.

— Dr. Lena Marsh
Head of Forensics, CID Laboratory
